prompt: Identify the spoken language in the provided audio. Answer with exactly one language code and nothing else. Do not provide any explanation.
output_normalization: strip + lowercase only; Whisper-style <|xx|> token wrapper accepted; no mapping from language names to codes
evaluation_setting: closed-set spoken language identification over languages present in the benchmark manifest
checkpoint_note: Checkpoint disk size includes components not necessarily loaded when enable_audio_output=False.
throughput_note: Request QPS values are sequential batch-1 service-rate proxies (1000 / mean latency), not load-tested concurrent throughput.
memory_note: Final deployment VRAM comparison uses process-level NVML.

latency_definition.model_latency: synchronized model.generate() including Qwen audio encoding and autoregressive generation
latency_definition.e2e_latency: local audio read/decode + multimodal audio preprocessing + H2D + model.generate() + decode + language-code normalization
